content: Biitta Bollanne Salon Diza Goyno Woga
Koyro caaqo qaalazan Xoossas goynniza wogaynne biitta bolla diza Xoossa Keeththi dees.
Kase nam7u kifilera diza dunkaaney giigetti dees; koyro kifilezan xomppe woththizasoynne xaraphpheezay qasse ukeththi dees; hessa he kifilezi dumma kifile geetettees.
Nam7anththo kifilezi nam7anththo magalashaappe guye baggara diza kifiley ubbaafe dumma geetettees.

Hessa giddon worqqafe oosettida exaane cuwasiza qeeri shel7e malaynne worqqan meeshettida caaqo qaala taabotay dees; he taabotaykka iza giddon mannay diza worqqa leematey, cililida Aaroone guufeynne caaqo qaalati iza bolla xaafettida masettida shuchchati deettes.
He taabotaza bolla diza nagarappe maaroteththa kamaza bolla ba qefera kammiza bonchcho kirubeti deettes; ha7i qasse nu heytantta issaa issaa gishshas shaakki shaakki haasayanaas dandayokko.
Wurikka hessaththo giigettidaappe guye qeeseti ba ooso polanaas dunkaanaas koyro kifile geleettes.

Gidikkoka ubbaafe giddotiza kifile qeeseta halaqay xalla gelees; hessika layththan issito xalla gidishin izi ba nagara gishshassinne derey erontta ooththida nagaraa gishshas shiishshiza yarsho suuth oykkontta mulekka gelenna.
Koyro dunkaanezi kase diza wode gede ubbaafe dumma geetettizaso efiza ogey he wode qoncce gidonttayssa Xillo Ayanay bessees.
Hessika hayssa ha wodezas leemiso gidishin kase shiiqiza yarshotinne coo imettiza imotati immizayta wozina shempisanaassinne mule geeshshanaas dandaybeettenna.
Heytantti wurikka ooraththa wogay yaana gakkanaas coo mela doona haasaya mala; qasseka istti muussa gishshassinne ushsha gishshas qasseka dumma dumma geesho wogata xalla.
Kirstoosa Suuth

Gidikkoka Kirstoosi buroppe yaanaas diza lo7o miishshatas qeeseta halaqa gididi qonccides; izi izan gelida dunkaanezi gitanne geeshsha; he dunkaanezi asa kushen oosettonttayssanne hayssa ha medheteththaafe gidenna.

Izi he dunkaanezan gelishe deyshata suuththinne wofano boorata suuth ekki gelibeenna; gido attiin as ashshanaas mernaas ba suuth ekkidi ubbaafe dumma geetettiza kifileza hara wode nam7anththo gelontta mala wurseththa gelo gelides.
Isttas kare bagga asateththay tunida asata bolla araciza deysha suuththinne wofano boorata suuththi hessaththoka yarshos xuugettida ussaa bidinththi istta geeshshizayssa gidikko,
mernaa Ayanan bana wosoy baynda yarsho ooththi Xoossas shiishshida Kirstoosa suuththi nuni de7o Xoossaas goynnanaas hayqeththa oosoppe nuna ay mala aaththi geeshshandee?

Hessa gishshas xeygettidayti isttas immana geetettida mernaa laata ekkana mala Kirstoosi ooraththa caaqos gaannatizaade gidides; koyro caaqoza garsan diza wode istti ooththida nagarappe geeyana mala istta gishshas izi hayqqides.
Bazay bazettizayssa gidikko bazidaade hayqo shaakki eranaas bessees.
Gaasoykka bazay minnizay bazidaadey hayqqiinna. Bazidaadey paxa dishin bazay aykkoka ooththenna.
Hessa gishshas koyro caaqo qaalay suuththi baynda minnibeenna.

Musey ba azazo wogaa deraas yooti simmidi deyshata suuththinne wofano boorata suuth haaththara ekkidi zo7o dorsa isken ecere wurce misatiza hisophphe geetettiza miththara ekkidi ba xaafida wogaa maxaafa bollaninne dereza bolla wuxxides.
«Intte naagana mala inttena Xoossi azazida caaqo qaala suuththay hayssa» gides.
Hessaththoka dunkaanezanne iza giddon diza ooso miishshaa ubbaa bolla suuth wuxxides.
Addafekka guuththa miishshati attishin hankko daro miishshay suuththan geeyanaas bessizayssa wogay azazees; suuththi gukkontta dishin maaroy baa.
Hessa gishshas salo miishshatas leemiso gididayti haytanttan geeyanayssi attenna shin; Salon diza miishshati gidikko hayssafekka aadhdhiza yarshon geeyanaas bessees.
Kirstoosi tumu dunkaaneys leemisonne asa kushen oosettida Xoossa Keeththe gelibeenna; gido attiin ha7i nu gishshas Xoossa sinththan beettanaas pude salo gelides.
Qeeseta halaqay ba suuth gidontta suuth ekkidi layththan layththan ubbaafe dumma kifile gelizayssaththo Kirstoosi bana yarshanaas pude salo shiretti shiretti gelibeenna.
Hessa mala gidizaakko Kirstoosi alamey medhettoosoppe haa simmiin daro wode meto ekkanaas bessees; ha7i qasse wode wurseththan bana yarshidi nagara digganaas wurseththas issito qonccides.
Hessaththoka asi issito hayqqees; hessafe kaallidi pirda sinththan eqqanaas giigi uttides.
Kirstoosi daro asa nagara digganaas issito yarshettides; nam7anththoka izi qonccana; hessi iza naagizaytas atoteth ekki yaanaas attiin nam7anththo zaari nagara tookkanaas gidenna.
